findings.title: Failed download drops only Content-Disposition; other file headers stay for onError
findings.description: dropDisposition removes Content-Disposition while state is NEW, but FileResponder.answer (FileResponder.java:86-108) has already set ETag, Last-Modified, Accept-Ranges, X-Content-Type-Options, Content-Type and Cache-Control before sendBody; a pre-commit IOException there leaves those file validators on the onError 500 answer. The FND-A006 header is fixed; the rest is the same class of leak.
findings.suggested_fix: On a pre-commit failure, remove every header answerFile/FileResponder added (snapshot names before respond), or defer them to commit.

findings.title: Production ResolverTap hook exists only for one reflection-based test
findings.description: A volatile ResolverTap field in StaticHandler, a per-request copy into DefaultResponse (Dispatcher.java:165, DefaultResponse.java:70,96) and FileResponder.tapped (FileResponder.java:31-39) were added to production code solely so FileResourceResolverTest:150-156 can wrap the resolver, and that test still needs reflection on Dispatcher.statics to reach it. Harmless at runtime (null tap) but extra surface and a volatile read per request.
findings.suggested_fix: Accept as a documented test seam, or set it once at construction instead of a mutable volatile.

findings.title: Heap-growth test depends on System.gc() hint and used-heap sampling
findings.description: The 8 MiB bound is measured as MemoryMXBean used heap after System.gc(), which is only a hint; with parallel forks or -XX:+DisableExplicitGC the delta can include unrelated garbage and flake.
findings.suggested_fix: Repeat gc and take the minimum sample; keep the bound.

findings.title: New lines exceed 120 columns
findings.description: StaticPath.java:21 (183 cols, javadoc) and StaticHandler.java:268 (133 cols) break the 120-column wrapping the rest of the code keeps.
